objective: Season2-only full 1300 collectible item prerequisite/purpose guide and Token/Badge instruction with server-authoritative add-on mastery draft, no production grants
productionBaselineEvidence: Train A production source 404c87e55c62a88c95c7389ac8665f237149702a and EAS Android update 01a1ee79-b1f1-7295-9d48-0238ffe0202a (runtime 1.3.2) are recorded in existing Season2 isolation architecture; no fresh production OTA or physical-device proof claimed.
chosenApproach: Use immutable canonical 13x20x5 names; add read-only bilingual instruction guides and correct legacy ownership display. Keep Season2 mastery receipts, optional Tokens and badges separated from existing Character claims and economics. SQL lives only under docs, not migrations.
selectionRationale: Legacy Character items already exist and may be owned; retroactive locks or adding token purchase to earned items would break S1. Isolated certification prevents phantom Owned states and permits future validated milestones without granting unearned rewards or changing permanent rank, QMP, BP, cash or ads.
alternativeApproaches: Retroactively lock all existing Character collectibles with new Season2 tasks: rejected, would revoke earned assets and mutate production semantics.
Client-only fake mission checkmarks or level-based automatic claim: rejected, vulnerable to duplicate/fabricated rewards and offers no verifiable backend evidence.
Publish an isolated preview first and apply only to a verified separate Main staging backend after SQL/RLS tests: selected.
